title: Replication package for "Ability, Credit Constraints, and the Observed Returns to Child Work"
description: Self-contained Python replication package for the working paper "Ability, Credit Constraints, and the Observed Returns to Child Work". Seven numbered scripts regenerate every table and figure in the paper: the population economies and omitted-variable-bias decomposition, the specification ladder, the selection-threshold and reversal-boundary verifications, the policy experiments with consumption-equivalent welfare accounting, the constrained-share robustness exercise, and the skill-building-channel robustness checks. Requires Python 3.9+ with numpy, scipy and matplotlib. All scripts are deterministic (fixed random seeds) and run in roughly 10-15 minutes in total. See the package README for the script-to-exhibit mapping.
